svg.text: Validity Period: 2025–2033 | 28 Initiatives | 3 Transformation Waves | USD 8.5M Midpoint Investment

g.text: 8 siloed information systems · 1 automated data flow
No HIE, no MPI, no EHR in public facilities
NHIS enrollment at ~30% of target (15–20K of 60K)
No unified digital health governance or directorate
OpenHIE-based HIE with 6 integration flows live
DHDD fully staffed (14 positions) with NDHSC governance
SPT · SMS for Health · Paper registers
Zero software licence fees — all investment goes to implementation, capacity, and infrastructure
Steady-state recurrent costs: ~USD 515,000/year (DHDD salaries, G-Cloud hosting, connectivity)
